question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is '**Defroded**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is '**Defrosted**'.
 
• The mistake is in the placement of the letters **'t' and 'd'.**
 
• The word means to remove ice or frost from a surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 '**Discrimination**' means unjust or prejudicial treatment of different categories of people.
 
• Option 3 '**Continuation**' means the act of continuing or the state of being continued.
 
• Option 4 '**Maintenance**' means the process of maintaining or preserving something.
